name: Egyptian God Divine Trinity
desc:
"Slifer the Sky Dragon" + "The Winged Dragon of Ra" + "Obelisk the Tormentor"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards from your field and/or GY. (You do not use "Polymerization".)
● This card is unaffected by other cards' effects.
● Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand.
● Once per turn: You can destroy all other monsters on the field, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each destroyed monster.
● If this card leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Slifer the Sky Dragon", 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra", and 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" from your hand, Deck, GY, or banished zone, ignoring their summoning conditions.

strings.str1: Once per turn: You can destroy all other monsters and inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each.
strings.str2: If this card leaves the field: You can Special Summon Slifer, Obelisk, and Ra.

script:
--Egyptian God Divine Trinity
local s,id=GetID()

function s.initial_effect(c)
	c:EnableReviveLimit()

	--========================
	-- Contact Fusion Procedure
	--========================
	aux.AddFusionProcMix(c,true,true,10000020,10000010,10000000)
	aux.AddContactFusionProcedure(c,s.contactfilter,LOCATION_MZONE+LOCATION_GRAVE,0,s.contactop)

	--========================
	--SP Summon condition
	--========================

	local e0=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e0:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e0:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE+EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
	e0:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION)
	e0:SetValue(s.splimit)
	c:RegisterEffect(e0)

	--========================
	-- Unaffected by other cards' effects
	--========================
	--local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	--e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	--e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_SINGLE_RANGE)
	--e1:SetRange(LOCATION_MZONE)
	--e1:SetCode(EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT)
	--e1:SetValue(s.efilter)
	--c:RegisterEffect(e1)

	--========================
	-- Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in hand
	--========================
	local e2=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e2:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e2:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK)
	e2:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_SINGLE_RANGE)
	e2:SetRange(LOCATION_MZONE)
	e2:SetValue(s.atkdefval)
	c:RegisterEffect(e2)
	local e3=e2:Clone()
	e3:SetCode(EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE)
	c:RegisterEffect(e3)

	--========================
	-- Optional: Destroy all other monsters and burn
	--========================
	local e4=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e4:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,0))
	e4:SetCategory(CATEGORY_DESTROY+CATEGORY_DAMAGE)
	e4:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_IGNITION)
	e4:SetRange(LOCATION_MZONE)
	e4:SetCountLimit(1)
	e4:SetTarget(s.destg)
	e4:SetOperation(s.desop)
	c:RegisterEffect(e4)

	--========================
	-- Revival on Leaving the Field (Optional, Delayed, with Unique Check)
	--========================
	local e5=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e5:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,1))
	e5:SetCategory(CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON)
	e5:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE+EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O)
	e5:SetCode(EVENT_LEAVE_FIELD)
	e5:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_DELAY)
	e5:SetCondition(s.revcon)
	e5:SetTarget(s.revtg)
	e5:SetOperation(s.revop)
	c:RegisterEffect(e5)
end

--========================
-- SP Summon Condition
--========================

function s.splimit(e,se,sp,st)
	return e:GetHandler():GetLocation()~=LOCATION_EXTRA
end

--========================
-- Contact Fusion Helpers
--========================

function s.contactfilter(c)
	return c:IsCode(10000020,10000010,10000000) and c:IsAbleToRemoveAsCost()
end

function s.contactop(g)
	Duel.Remove(g,POS_FACEUP,REASON_COST)
end

--========================
-- Effect Immunity
--========================

function s.efilter(e,te)
	return te:GetOwner()~=e:GetOwner()
end

--========================
-- ATK/DEF Scaling
--========================

function s.atkdefval(e,c)
	return Duel.GetFieldGroupCount(c:GetControler(),LOCATION_HAND,0)*1000
end

--========================
-- Destroy & Burn
--========================

function s.destg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(aux.TRUE,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,e:GetHandler())
	if chk==0 then return #g>0 end
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_DESTROY,g,#g,0,0)
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_DAMAGE,nil,0,1-tp,#g*1000)
end

function s.desop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(aux.TRUE,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,e:GetHandler())
	local ct=Duel.Destroy(g,REASON_EFFECT)
	if ct>0 then
		Duel.Damage(1-tp,ct*1000,REASON_EFFECT)
	end
end

--========================
-- Revival Effect
--========================

function s.revcon(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	return e:GetHandler():IsPreviousControler(tp)
end

function s.revfilter(c,e,tp)
	return c:IsCode(10000020,10000010,10000000)
		and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,true,true)
end

function s.revtg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then
		if Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)<3 then return false end
		local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.revfilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_GRAVE+LOCATION_REMOVED,0,nil,e,tp)
		return g:GetClassCount(Card.GetCode)>=3
			and g:IsExists(Card.IsCode,1,nil,10000020) -- Slifer
			and g:IsExists(Card.IsCode,1,nil,10000010) -- Ra
			and g:IsExists(Card.IsCode,1,nil,10000000) -- Obelisk
	end
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON,nil,3,tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_GRAVE+LOCATION_REMOVED)
end

function s.revop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	if Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)<3 then return end
	local loc=LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_GRAVE+LOCATION_REMOVED
	local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(aux.NecroValleyFilter(s.revfilter),tp,loc,0,nil,e,tp)
	local codes = {10000020, 10000010, 10000000} -- Slifer, Ra, Obelisk

	for _,code in ipairs(codes) do
		if Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)<=0 then break end
		local sg=g:Filter(Card.IsCode,nil,code)
		local tc=sg:GetFirst()
		if tc then
			Duel.SpecialSummonStep(tc,0,tp,tp,true,true,POS_FACEUP)
		end
	end
	Duel.SpecialSummonComplete()
end

name: Obelisk the Tormentor - Crusher
desc:
Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). 
①：If your opponent controls 3 or more monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. 
②：Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 2 "God Tokens" (Fairy/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), but they cannot be used as Fusion, Synchro or Link Material. 
③：You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Obelisk the Tormentor" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then you can add 1 card that lists "Obelisk the Tormentor" in its text from your Deck to your hand, except "Obelisk the Tormentor - Crusher". The monster Special Summoned by this effect does not activate its effect that sends it to the GY during the End Phase.

script:
--Obelisk the Tormentor - Crusher

local s,id=GetID()
function s.initial_effect(c)
	c:EnableReviveLimit()
	--summon with 3 tribute
	local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e1:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,7))
	e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE+EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
	e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e1:SetCode(EFFECT_LIMIT_SUMMON_PROC)
	e1:SetCondition(s.ttcon)
	e1:SetOperation(s.ttop)
	e1:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_ADVANCE)
	c:RegisterEffect(e1)
	local e2=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e2:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e2:SetCode(EFFECT_LIMIT_SET_PROC)
	e2:SetCondition(s.setcon)
	c:RegisterEffect(e2)
	--summon
	local e3=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e3:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e3:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_DISABLE_SUMMON)
	e3:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE+EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
	c:RegisterEffect(e3)
	--summon success
	local e4=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e4:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE+EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS)
	e4:SetCode(EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS)
	e4:SetOperation(s.sumsuc)
	c:RegisterEffect(e4)
	-- Normal Summon with 3 Tributes or without Tributing if the opponent controls 3 or more monsters
	local e5=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e5:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,1))
	e5:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE+EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
	e5:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e5:SetCode(EFFECT_LIMIT_SUMMON_PROC)
	e5:SetRange(LOCATION_HAND)
	e5:SetCondition(s.ntcon)
	e5:SetOperation(s.ntop)
	e5:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_ADVANCE)
	c:RegisterEffect(e5)
	-- Special Summon God Tokens
	local e6=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e6:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,0))
	e6:SetCategory(CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON+CATEGORY_TOKEN)
	e6:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_IGNITION)
	e6:SetRange(LOCATION_MZONE)
	e6:SetCountLimit(1,id)
	e6:SetTarget(s.tktg)
	e6:SetOperation(s.tkop)
	c:RegisterEffect(e6)
	-- Special Summon Obelisk the Tormentor
	local e7=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e7:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,2))
	e7:SetCategory(CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON+CATEGORY_SEARCH+CATEGORY_TOHAND)
	e7:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_IGNITION)
	e7:SetRange(LOCATION_MZONE)
	e7:SetCost(s.spcost)
	e7:SetTarget(s.sptg)
	e7:SetOperation(s.spop)
	c:RegisterEffect(e7)
end

function s.ttcon(e,c,minc)
	if c==nil then return true end
	return minc<=3 and Duel.CheckTribute(c,3)
end

function s.ttop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
	local g=Duel.SelectTribute(tp,c,3,3)
	c:SetMaterial(g)
	Duel.Release(g,REASON_SUMMON+REASON_MATERIAL)
end

function s.setcon(e,c,minc)
	if not c then return true end
	return false
end

function s.sumsuc(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	Duel.SetChainLimitTillChainEnd(aux.FALSE)
end

-- Normal Summon condition without Tributing

function s.ntcon(e,c,minc)
	if c==nil then return true end
	local _,max=c:GetTributeRequirement()
	return max>0 and Duel.GetLocationCount(c:GetControler(),LOCATION_MZONE)>0 and Duel.GetFieldGroupCount(c:GetControler(),0,LOCATION_MZONE)>2 
end

function s.ntop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c,minc)
	if minc==0 then return end
	local mg=Duel.SelectTribute(tp,c,3,3)
	c:SetMaterial(mg)
	Duel.Release(mg,REASON_SUMMON+REASON_MATERIAL)
end

-- Special Summon God Tokens

function s.tktg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then return true end
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_TOKEN,nil,2,tp,0)
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON,nil,2,tp,0)
end

function s.tkop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local c=e:GetHandler()
	local ft=Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)
	if ft>1 and Duel.IsPlayerAffectedByEffect(tp,59822133) then ft=1 end
	if ft<2 then return end 
	if Duel.IsPlayerCanSpecialSummonMonster(tp,130000002,0,TYPES_TOKEN,0,0,1,RACE_FAIRY,ATTRIBUTE_DARK) then
	for i=1,2 do
	local token=Duel.CreateToken(tp,130000002) --This is the Code for the God Tokens
		Duel.SpecialSummonStep(token,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP)
		--Cannot be used as fusion material 
		local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
		e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
		e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
		e1:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_FUSION_MATERIAL)
		e1:SetValue(1)
		e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD)
		token:RegisterEffect(e1,true)
		--Cannot be used as synchro material 
		local e2=e1:Clone()
		e2:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL)
		token:RegisterEffect(e2,true)
		--Cannot be used as link material 
		local e3=e1:Clone()
		e3:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_LINK_MATERIAL)
		token:RegisterEffect(e3,true)
		end
	Duel.SpecialSummonComplete()
	end
end

-- Special Summon Obelisk the Tormentor

function s.spcost(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then return e:GetHandler():IsReleasable() end
	Duel.Release(e:GetHandler(),REASON_COST)
end

function s.spfilter(c,e,tp)
	return c:IsCode(10000000) and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,true,false)
end

function s.thfilter(c)
	return c:IsAbleToHand() and c:IsSetCard(0xfaa) and not c:IsCode(10000000)
end

function s.sptg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then return Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0 
	and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,e,tp) end
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK)
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_TOHAND,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_DECK)
end

function s.spop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
		if Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)<=0 then return end
		Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON)
		local sc=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,0,1,1,nil,e,tp):GetFirst()
	if sc and Duel.SpecialSummon(sc,0,tp,tp,false,false,POS_FACEUP)>0 then
	sc:CompleteProcedure()
	local g2=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.thfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,nil)
		if #g2>0 and Duel.SelectYesNo(tp,aux.Stringid(id,3)) then
		Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_ATOHAND)
		Duel.BreakEffect()
		local sg=g2:Select(tp,1,1,nil)
		Duel.SendtoHand(sg,nil,REASON_EFFECT)
		Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,sg)
	end
		sc:RegisterFlagEffect(id,RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD,0,1)
		local ObeliskTGVEffect=EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD+EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_F --we create a variable for the effect for Obelisk Activation when sent to GV
		local effs={sc:GetCardEffect()}
			if not effs then return false end
			for _, eff in ipairs(effs) do
			if (eff:GetType()&ObeliskTGVEffect)>0 then
				eff:SetCondition(aux.AND(s.obeliskeffcon,eff:GetCondition())) --i dont know how i can explain, but like we remove the condition for the Obelisk to not to send to GV During End Phase
			end
		end
	end
end

function s.obeliskeffcon(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	return not e:GetHandler():HasFlagEffect(id)
end

Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect.
①：You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" from either player's field to the GY. This card cannot attack this turn if you Tributed a monster your opponent controls. 
②：If this card is sent from the field to the GY by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then send 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix" from your hand or Deck to the GY.

script:
--The Winged Dragon of Ra - Deformation Mode
local s,id=GetID()
function s.initial_effect(c)
	c:EnableReviveLimit()

	--Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set
	local e0=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e0:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e0:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE+EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
	e0:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION)
	c:RegisterEffect(e0)

	--Special Summon itself from hand or Deck
	local e3=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e3:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD)
	e3:SetCode(EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC)
	e3:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE)
	e3:SetRange(LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)
	e3:SetCondition(s.spcon)
	e3:SetOperation(s.spop)
	e3:SetValue(SUMMON_TYPE_SPECIAL)
	c:RegisterEffect(e3)

	--Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra" and send "Immortal Phoenix"
	local e4=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e4:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,1))
	e4:SetCategory(CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON+CATEGORY_TOGRAVE)
	e4:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE+EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O)
	e4:SetCode(EVENT_TO_GRAVE)
	e4:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP+EFFECT_FLAG_DELAY)
	e4:SetCondition(s.rapcon)
	e4:SetTarget(s.raptg)
	e4:SetOperation(s.rapop)
	c:RegisterEffect(e4)
end

--Condition to check "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" is on the field
function s.filter(c)
	return c:IsFaceup() and c:IsCode(10000080) and c:IsAbleToGraveAsCost()  -- "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode" ID
end

function s.spcon(e,c)
	if c==nil then return true end
	local tp=c:GetControler()
	return Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,1,nil)
end

function s.spop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c)
	local g=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.filter,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,1,1,nil)
	Duel.SendtoGrave(g,REASON_COST)
	-- If the card was an opponent's, restrict the attack
	if g:GetFirst():IsControler(1-tp) then
		local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
		e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
		e1:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_ATTACK)
		e1:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_IGNORE_IMMUNE+EFFECT_FLAG_OATH)
		e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT+RESET_TOFIELD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END)
		c:RegisterEffect(e1)
	end
end

--Condition to check if sent to the GY by opponent's card
function s.rapcon(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	return e:GetHandler():IsPreviousControler(tp) and rp==1-tp
		and e:GetHandler():IsReason(REASON_EFFECT+REASON_BATTLE)
end

--Target: Special Summon "The Winged Dragon of Ra" and send "Immortal Phoenix" to the GY
function s.raptg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then return Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0
		and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.rafilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,e,tp) end
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_TOGRAVE,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_DECK)
end

function s.rafilter(c,e,tp)
	return c:IsCode(10000010) and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,true,true)  -- "The Winged Dragon of Ra" ID
end

function s.phoenixfilter(c)
	return c:IsCode(10000090)  -- "The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix" ID
end

function s.rapop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	if Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)<=0 then return end
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON)
	local g=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.rafilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK,0,1,1,nil,e,tp)
	local tc=g:GetFirst()
	if tc and Duel.SpecialSummon(tc,0,tp,tp,true,true,POS_FACEUP)~=0 then
		tc:CompleteProcedure()
		Duel.BreakEffect()  -- Ensure this effect happens after the summon
		local phoenix=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.phoenixfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,1,nil)
		if phoenix:GetCount()>0 then
			Duel.SendtoGrave(phoenix,REASON_EFFECT)
		end
	end
end

	local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e1:SetDescription(aux.Stringid(id,0))
	e1:SetCategory(CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON+CATEGORY_NEGATE)
	e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_QUICK_O)
	e1:SetCode(EVENT_CHAINING)
	e1:SetRange(LOCATION_HAND)
	e1:SetCountLimit(1,id)
	e1:SetCondition(s.spcon)
	e1:SetTarget(s.sptg)
	e1:SetOperation(s.spop)

end

-- Filter: target 1 monster whose original attribute is DIVINE

end

	if chk==0 then return Duel.IsExistingTarget(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,LOCATION_MZONE,1,nil) end

	local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(e:GetHandler())
	e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD)
	e1:SetCode(EFFECT_CANNOT_ATTACK)
	e1:SetTargetRange(LOCATION_MZONE,0)
	e1:SetTarget(function(e,c) return c~=tc end)
	e1:SetReset(RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END)

	e2:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD)
	e2:SetCode(EFFECT_SKIP_M2)
	e2:SetProperty(EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET)
	e2:SetTargetRange(1,0)

		{true, aux.Stringid(id,0), 1}, -- Each player draws to 6
		{true, aux.Stringid(id,1), 2}, -- Inflict 4000 damage
		{Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(aux.TRUE,tp,0,LOCATION_MZONE,1,nil), aux.Stringid(id,2), 3} -- Send opponent’s monsters
	)

		local h1=Duel.GetFieldGroupCount(tp,LOCATION_HAND,0)
		local h2=Duel.GetFieldGroupCount(1-tp,LOCATION_HAND,0)
		if h1 < 6 then Duel.Draw(tp,6-h1,REASON_EFFECT) end
		if h2 < 6 then Duel.Draw(1-tp,6-h2,REASON_EFFECT) end
	elseif opt == 2 then

		Duel.Damage(1-tp,4000,REASON_EFFECT)
	elseif opt == 3 then
		-- Send all monsters on opponent's field to the GY
		local g=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(aux.TRUE,tp,0,LOCATION_MZONE,nil)
		Duel.SendtoGrave(g,REASON_EFFECT)
	end
end

		and c:IsCanBeXyzMaterial(xyzc)

		and c:IsCode(CODE_SANGA,CODE_KAZEJIN,CODE_SUIJIN)

-- Group goal: at least 3 total; Extra Deck zone free; must-material checks pass
local function xyz_goal(sg,tp,xyzc)
	if #sg<3 then return false end
	if Duel.GetLocationCountFromEx(tp,tp,sg,xyzc)<=0 then return false end
	-- Respect "must be Xyz material" constraints if any exist
	-- (Auxiliary.MustMaterialCheck exists in your procedures)
	if not Auxiliary.MustMaterialCheck(sg,tp,EFFECT_MUST_BE_XMATERIAL) then return false end
	return true
end

function s.xyzcon(e,c,og,min,max)
	if c==nil then return true end
	local tp=c:GetControler()
	-- Collect candidates
	local mgM=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.mfilterM,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil,c)
	local mgS=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.mfilterS,tp,LOCATION_SZONE,0,nil)
	local mg=mgM:Clone()
	if #mgS>0 then mg:Merge(mgS) end
	-- Quick pre-check
	if #mg<3 then return false end
	-- Must-material rule cards
	local sg=Duel.GetMustMaterial(tp,EFFECT_MUST_BE_XMATERIAL)
	if #sg>0 and sg:IsExists(function(x) return not mg:IsContains(x) end,1,nil) then
		return false
	end
	-- Can we find any valid subgroup?
	Duel.SetSelectedCard(sg)
	return mg:CheckSubGroup(xyz_goal,3,99,tp,c)
end

	local mgM=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.mfilterM,tp,LOCATION_MZONE,0,nil,c)
	local mgS=Duel.GetMatchingGroup(s.mfilterS,tp,LOCATION_SZONE,0,nil)
	local mg=mgM:Clone()
	if #mgS>0 then mg:Merge(mgS) end
	-- Must-material rule cards
	local must=Duel.GetMustMaterial(tp,EFFECT_MUST_BE_XMATERIAL)
	Duel.SetSelectedCard(must)
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_XMATERIAL)
	local cancel=Duel.IsSummonCancelable()
	local sg=mg:SelectSubGroup(tp,xyz_goal,cancel,3,99,tp,c)
	if not sg then return false end
	sg:KeepAlive()
	e:SetLabelObject(sg)
	return true
end

function s.xyzop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,c,og,min,max)
	local g=e:GetLabelObject() -- selected materials
	-- If any of them had overlays (Xyz), send those to GY by rule first
	local over=Group.CreateGroup()
	for mc in aux.Next(g) do
		local ogp=mc:GetOverlayGroup()
		if #ogp>0 then over:Merge(ogp) end
	end
	if #over>0 then Duel.SendtoGrave(over,REASON_RULE) end

	g:DeleteGroup()

function s.ngcost(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	local c=e:GetHandler()
	local og=c:GetOverlayGroup()
	if chk==0 then return #og>0 end
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_REMOVEXYZ)
	local cg=og:Select(tp,1,1,nil)
	local rc=cg:GetFirst()
	-- Detach by sending to GY as cost (standard for choosing a specific material)
	Duel.SendtoGrave(cg,REASON_COST)
	-- Flag if it was one of the pieces
	if rc and rc:IsCode(CODE_SANGA,CODE_KAZEJIN,CODE_SUIJIN) then
		e:SetLabel(1)
	else
		e:SetLabel(0)
	end
end

function s.ngfilter(c)
	-- Face-up opponent’s card whose effects can be negated
	return c:IsFaceup() and not (c:IsDisabled())
end
function s.ngtg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk,chkc)
	if chkc then return chkc:IsOnField() and chkc:IsControler(1-tp) and s.ngfilter(chkc) end
	if chk==0 then return Duel.IsExistingTarget(s.ngfilter,tp,0,LOCATION_ONFIELD,1,nil) end
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_FACEUP)
	local g=Duel.SelectTarget(tp,s.ngfilter,tp,0,LOCATION_ONFIELD,1,1,nil)
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_DISABLE,g,1,0,0)
	if e:GetLabel()==1 then
		Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_REMOVE,g,1,0,0)
	end
end
function s.ngop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local c=e:GetHandler()
	local tc=Duel.GetFirstTarget()
	if not tc or not tc:IsRelateToEffect(e) or not tc:IsFaceup() then return end
	-- Negate effects until the end of this turn
	local e1=Effect.CreateEffect(c)
	e1:SetType(EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE)
	e1:SetCode(EFFECT_DISABLE)
	e1:SetReset(RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END)
	tc:RegisterEffect(e1)
	local e2=e1:Clone()
	e2:SetCode(EFFECT_DISABLE_EFFECT)
	tc:RegisterEffect(e2)
	if tc:IsType(TYPE_TRAPMONSTER) then
		local e3=e1:Clone()
		e3:SetCode(EFFECT_DISABLE_TRAPMONSTER)
		tc:RegisterEffect(e3)
	end
	-- If detached one of the pieces, also banish the target
	if e:GetLabel()==1 and tc:IsRelateToEffect(e) and tc:IsAbleToRemove() then
		Duel.Remove(tc,POS_FACEUP,REASON_EFFECT)
	end
end

function s.spcon(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	local c=e:GetHandler()
	return c:IsPreviousLocation(LOCATION_ONFIELD) and (r&(REASON_BATTLE+REASON_EFFECT))~=0
end
function s.spfilter(c,e,tp)
	-- Level 9 "Gate Guardian" Extra Deck monster (ignore Summon conditions)
	return c:IsLevel(9) and c:IsSetCard(0x52) and c:IsType(TYPE_MONSTER)
		and c:IsCanBeSpecialSummoned(e,0,tp,true,true)
end
function s.sptg(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)
	if chk==0 then
		return Duel.GetLocationCountFromEx(tp,tp,nil,e:GetHandler())>0
			and Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,1,nil,e,tp)
	end
	Duel.SetOperationInfo(0,CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON,nil,1,tp,LOCATION_EXTRA)
end
function s.spop(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp)
	Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_SPSUMMON)
	local g=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_EXTRA,0,1,1,nil,e,tp)
	local tc=g:GetFirst()
	if tc then
		Duel.SpecialSummon(tc,0,tp,tp,true,true,POS_FACEUP)
	end
end
